offline.name: startup_use_existing_no_credentials_branch
offline.reason: StartScene::performExistingLoginAttempt retains readiness checks, then follows its existing no-token path: this+0x353=1 and hides the login wait UI. It skips both access-token and username-token requests.

offline.name: arcahv_use_ordinary_chart_loader
offline.reason: Skip the Arcahv special challenge factory in the GameScene modifier selector and continue with the ordinary song/chart loader. This static change applies to all modes using this selector.

offline.name: skip_saved_registration_landing_prompt
offline.reason: Always take the existing false-preference branch after reading showRegistrationWelcomeDialogOnLanding; leave saved preferences untouched.

offline.name: skip_saved_verification_landing_prompt
offline.reason: Always take the existing false-preference branch after reading showVerificationPromptOnLanding; leave saved preferences untouched.

full_catalogue.name: offline_catalog_pack_available
full_catalogue.reason: Full offline catalog only: use the existing true return of the local Pack ownership predicate. It reads a local pointer list and has no account/server writes. Required to retain original set/pack grouping for bundled complete songs.

full_catalogue.name: offline_catalog_song_available
full_catalogue.reason: Full offline catalog only: use the existing true return of the local Song ownership predicate. Empty purchase metadata does not bypass its Pack pointer membership check. Retains normal chart existence, difficulty and asset checks outside this ownership-only function.

full_catalogue.name: offline_epilogue_pack_visible
full_catalogue.reason: Pack constructor 0xfd634c sets +0xb8 only for epilogue. Skip its story-progress display gate in the offline catalog; continue normal pack availability and return logic. Does not modify story completion or trigger its scene modifier.

full_catalogue.name: ordinary_song_uses_existing_no_modifier_path
full_catalogue.reason: The existing selector clears/releases scene+0x308 for mode 2. Testing all bits except bit 1 extends that same path to ordinary mode 0, preserving behavior for every other mode. This avoids story/challenge modifiers and their extra media while keeping the ordinary AFF loader and scenecontrols.

full_catalogue.name: existing_local_chart_has_normal_display_flags
full_catalogue.reason: After the original chart-existence test, initialize the five ordinary unlocked display flags to zero. Avoids hardcoded story/Inscribed gates and the unchecked null UnlockCondition dereference used by Black Fate songs.

full_catalogue.name: existing_local_chart_has_no_lock_reason
full_catalogue.reason: Companion to the existing-chart display patch: return reason zero. The original missing-chart reason-one path at 0x1809428 remains intact.

full_catalogue.name: existing_local_chart_returns_display_state
full_catalogue.reason: Return through the original stack-cookie check and register-restoring epilogue before any temporary strings or vectors are allocated. Returns {flags=0, reason=0} only after Song::hasDifficulty succeeds.

full_catalogue.name: existing_local_chart_is_playable
full_catalogue.reason: After original null-Song and chart-existence guards, select the existing true result for offline playability. Skips cached account and Final Verdict/Silent Answer story progression prerequisites, not file validation.

full_catalogue.name: existing_local_chart_returns_playable
full_catalogue.reason: Companion playability branch into the original cookie check and epilogue, before temporary allocations. Null Song and absent difficulty still return false.

full_catalogue.name: bundled_beyond_uses_local_asset_checks
full_catalogue.reason: remote_dl=false now skips the separate BYD downloader cache/token gate too. Real AFF existence at 0xd2a424 and audio file existence at 0xd2a46c are retained; a remote_dl=true song still follows its original path.

full_catalogue.name: ordinary_start_skips_story_introduction
full_catalogue.reason: After successful real AFF/audio checks, non-World starts continue through the existing normal callback instead of the last/lasteternity story-introduction branch. World mode 1 is unchanged. No temporary object lifetime crosses the skipped block; avoids requiring story media or changing cached narrative progress for practice.

full_catalogue.name: diein_etr_has_no_offline_purchase_requirement
full_catalogue.reason: Use the existing false return of the DIE IN ETR extra purchase-requirement helper after its song-id string is released. All callers are covered. Its old ETR body dereferences the absent Unlock object at 0x8a62b8 via 0x1313478, even when pack ownership already succeeds. This helper does not load chart/audio assets.

full_catalogue.name: aethercrest_etr_has_no_offline_purchase_requirement
full_catalogue.reason: Aether Crest has the same collaboration ETR requirement helper and unchecked null Unlock call at 0x114e4b0. Return false through its original epilogue, after string cleanup and before allocating purchase pack lists. Ordinary chart-existence and file checks remain outside.

full_catalogue.name: bundled_assets_have_no_download_requirements
full_catalogue.reason: The download requirement factory initializes an empty result vector before reading Song::remote_dl at +0x1c0. For bundled songs, release the copied song-id string and return that vector through the existing epilogue. The old branch still appended BYD/Inscribed and additional download keys, making selection UI consult server cache despite local assets. Remote songs keep their original requirements; Start retains real AFF and audio checks.

full_catalogue.name: bundled_beyond_chart_uses_local_aff_path
full_catalogue.reason: The AFF path getter already routes remote_dl=true songs to the download cache before this instruction. Remove the remaining local difficulty-3 exception so bundled BYD and Inscribed use songs/<id>/3.aff through the same path builder as other local charts. Both actual chart existence checks and GameScene/AFF loading use this getter. Remote routing, path cleanup and missing-file checks remain unchanged.
